```{r build-od-parquet}
# The raw OD CSVs are far larger than memory (bus: ~18 GB in total), so we do
# not load them all at once. Instead, every monthly CSV in data/raw/OD/ is
# converted once into a Parquet dataset in data/processed/od_parquet/
# (about 8x smaller on disk). Months already converted are skipped, so this
# chunk is slow only the first time and after new months are downloaded.
build_od_parquet()

od <- open_od() # lazy: nothing is read into memory yet
od
```

```{r settings}
# Sample months: March, June, September, December of each year
months_sel <- c(202103, 202106, 202109, 202112,
                202203, 202206, 202209, 202212,
                202303, 202306, 202309, 202312,
                202403, 202406, 202409, 202412,
                202503, 202506, 202509, 202512,
                202603, 202606, 202609)

# Time periods and labels used in file names
period_prefix <- c("AM peak"          = "am_peak",
                   "PM peak"          = "pm_peak",
                   "Weekday off-peak" = "offpeak",
                   "Weekend/holiday"  = "weekend")

# COVID phase, following Hou et al. (2025)
phase_file <- c("SD control" = "sd_control", "Non-control" = "non_control")
phase_of   <- function(year, month) {
  if_else(year * 100 + month <= 202203, "SD control", "Non-control")
}

# Four centres, each defined as a set of subzones (team definition)
area_center    <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL", "ANSON",
                    "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS",
                    "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")
area_jurong    <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK",
                    "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)")
area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")
area_tampines  <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")

centres   <- c("CBD", "Jurong Lake District", "Woodlands", "Tampines")
centre_sz <- list("CBD"                  = area_center,
                  "Jurong Lake District" = area_jurong,
                  "Woodlands"            = area_woodlands,
                  "Tampines"             = area_tampines)

dir.create(here("outputs"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r load-od}
od_train_21_26 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "train", YYYYMM %in% months_sel) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    YEAR  = YYYYMM %/% 100L,
    MONTH = YYYYMM %% 100L,
    period = case_when(
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% c(6, 7, 8, 9)     ~ "AM peak",
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% c(17, 18, 19, 20) ~ "PM peak",
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY"                                        ~ "Weekday off-peak",
      TRUE                                                         ~ "Weekend/holiday"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, ORIGIN_PT_CODE, DESTINATION_PT_CODE) |>
  summarise(trips = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(covid_phase = phase_of(YEAR, MONTH))

od_train_21_26 %>% count(YEAR, MONTH, period)   # Check: 4 periods per month

# Number of sample months in each phase (for monthly averages)
od_train_21_26 %>%
  distinct(YEAR, MONTH, covid_phase) %>%
  count(covid_phase, name = "n_months") -> phase_months

phase_months
```

```{r lookup station code}
  transmute(
    stn_code = str_to_upper(str_squish(stn_code)),
    station_name = str_to_upper(str_squish(mrt_station_english))
  ) %>%
  distinct(stn_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r relate code to station name}
tibble(pt_code = unique(c(od_train_21_26$ORIGIN_PT_CODE,
                          od_train_21_26$DESTINATION_PT_CODE))) %>%
  mutate(code1 = str_split_i(pt_code, "[/-]", 1),    # "EW24/NS1" as "EW24"
         code2 = str_split_i(pt_code, "[/-]", 2)) %>%  # singal code as NA
  left_join(station_lookup %>% rename(name1 = station_name),
            by = c("code1" = "stn_code")) %>%
  left_join(station_lookup %>% rename(name2 = station_name),
            by = c("code2" = "stn_code"), na_matches = "never") %>%
  mutate(station_name = coalesce(name1, name2)) %>%   #recheck
  select(pt_code, station_name) -> code_lookup

code_lookup %>% filter(is.na(station_name))
```

```{r define 4 centers}
code_sz <- code_sz %>%
  mutate(centre = case_when(
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_center    ~ "CBD",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong    ~ "Jurong Lake District",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands ~ "Woodlands",
    SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines  ~ "Tampines",
    TRUE                          ~ "Other"
  ))

code_sz %>%
  filter(centre != "Other") %>%
  arrange(centre, station_name) %>%
  select(centre, station_name, SUBZONE_N)
```

```{r join centre to od}
od_train_21_26 <- od_train_21_26 %>%
  left_join(code_sz %>% select(pt_code, origin_stn = station_name,
                               origin_sz = SUBZONE_N, origin_centre = centre),
            by = c("ORIGIN_PT_CODE" = "pt_code")) %>%
  left_join(code_sz %>% select(pt_code, dest_stn = station_name,

            by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "pt_code"))

sum(is.na(od_train_21_26$origin_centre))
```

```{r regional od flows}
# Table 1: centre-to-centre flow matrix (including "Other")
# Shows where each centre's trips come from and go to, and how strongly
# each centre is linked to the CBD
od_train_21_26 %>%
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, origin_centre, dest_centre) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(trips), .groups = "drop") -> od_centre

# Table 2: flows from every station to each of the four centres
# Used for mapping each centre's catchment (which stations send trips to it)
od_train_21_26 %>%
  filter(dest_centre != "Other") %>%
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, dest_centre, origin_stn, origin_sz) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(trips), .groups = "drop") -> od_station_to_centre

# Check: flows between centres, March 2023, AM peak
od_centre %>%
  filter(YEAR == 2023, MONTH == 3, period == "AM peak") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dest_centre, values_from = trips)
```

```{r three indicators}
# For each centre, sum inflow, outflow, internal trips and trips to the CBD
map(centres, function(cc) {
  od_centre %>%
    group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period) %>%
    summarise(
      centre   = cc,
      inflow   = sum(trips[dest_centre == cc & origin_centre != cc]),
      outflow  = sum(trips[origin_centre == cc & dest_centre != cc]),
      internal = sum(trips[origin_centre == cc & dest_centre == cc]),
      to_cbd   = sum(trips[origin_centre == cc & dest_centre == "CBD"]),
      total    = sum(trips),   # all trips island-wide
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
    mutate(
      YEAR_MONTH = sprintf("%d-%02d", YEAR, MONTH),                  # "2023-03"
      zone       = recode(centre, "Jurong Lake District" = "Jurong East"),
      arrivals   = inflow,                                           # trips entering from outside
      attraction = inflow / total,                                   # share of island-wide trips
      cbd_outflow_share = to_cbd / (outflow + internal),   # trips to CBD stations / all departures
      in_out_ratio      = inflow / outflow,
      covid_phase = phase_of(YEAR, MONTH)
    ) %>% # Team format: share of arrivals among the four hubs
    group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period) %>%
    mutate(
      total_hub_arrivals = sum(arrivals),
      arrival_share      = arrivals / total_hub_arrivals
    ) %>%
    ungroup() -> indicators
```

```{r trip distance}
# Station coordinates (EPSG:3414, metres)
m_station %>%
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
         y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(station_name, x, y) -> stn_xy

# Average straight-line distance of trips entering each centre from outside
od_train_21_26 %>%
  filter(dest_centre != "Other", origin_centre != dest_centre) %>%
  left_join(stn_xy %>% rename(ox = x, oy = y), by = c("origin_stn" = "station_name")) %>%
  left_join(stn_xy %>% rename(dx = x, dy = y), by = c("dest_stn" = "station_name")) %>%
  mutate(dist_km = sqrt((ox - dx)^2 + (oy - dy)^2) / 1000) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, MONTH, period, centre = dest_centre) %>%
  summarise(mean_dist_km = weighted.mean(dist_km, trips, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") -> trip_distance

# Add distance to the indicator table
indicators <- indicators %>%
  left_join(trip_distance, by = c("YEAR", "MONTH", "period", "centre"))
```

```{r 4indicators table}
indicators %>%

  summarise(
    n_months          = n(),
    attraction        = mean(attraction),
    in_out_ratio      = mean(in_out_ratio),
    cbd_outflow_share = mean(cbd_outflow_share),   # NA for the CBD
    mean_dist_km      = mean(mean_dist_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    covid_phase = factor(covid_phase, levels = c("SD control", "Non-control")),
    period      = factor(period, levels = names(period_prefix)),
    zone        = factor(zone, levels = c("CBD", "Jurong East", "Woodlands", "Tampines"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(covid_phase, period, zone) -> indicator_means

indicator_means %>% filter(covid_phase == "SD control")  %>% select(-covid_phase) -> means_sd
indicator_means %>% filter(covid_phase == "Non-control") %>% select(-covid_phase) -> means_non

# Formatted table for the report
# Formatted tables for the report: one per time period, same layout as the bus tables
make_period_kable <- function(period_name, title) {
  indicator_means %>%
    filter(period == period_name) %>%
    mutate(
      centre = recode(as.character(zone), "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"),
      centre = factor(centre, levels = c("Woodlands", "Tampines",
                                         "Jurong Lake District", "CBD")),
      phase  = recode(as.character(covid_phase), "SD control" = "SD Control")
    ) %>%
    arrange(centre, covid_phase) %>%
    transmute(
      centre, phase,
      attraction   = round(attraction * 100, 2),
      in_out_ratio = round(in_out_ratio, 2),
      cbd_outflow  = round(cbd_outflow_share * 100, 2),
      mean_dist_km = round(mean_dist_km, 2)
    ) %>%
    kbl(caption = title,
        col.names = c("Centre", "Period", "Attraction (%)", "In/Out Ratio",
                      "CBD Outflow (%)", "Average Distance (km)"),
        align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "middle")
}

options(knitr.kable.NA = "–")   # CBD outflow share is not defined for the CBD itself

make_period_kable("AM peak",
                  "Comparison of MRT Mobility Indicators between SD Control and Non-control Periods (AM Peak)")
make_period_kable("PM peak",
                  "Comparison of MRT Mobility Indicators between SD Control and Non-control Periods (PM Peak)")
make_period_kable("Weekend/holiday",
                  "Comparison of MRT Mobility Indicators between SD Control and Non-control Periods (Weekend)")
```

```{r arrivals csv}
# YEAR_MONTH | zone | <period>_arrivals | total_hub_arrivals | arrival_share_cores |
# total_island_trips | arrival_share_island
for (p in names(period_prefix)) {
  prefix <- period_prefix[[p]]

  tbl <- indicators %>%
    filter(period == p) %>%
    transmute(YEAR_MONTH, covid_phase, zone,
              "{prefix}_arrivals" := arrivals,
              total_hub_arrivals,
              arrival_share_cores  = arrival_share,
              total_island_trips   = total,
              arrival_share_island = attraction) %>%
    arrange(YEAR_MONTH, zone)

  for (ph in names(phase_file)) {
    tbl %>%
      filter(covid_phase == ph) %>%
      select(-covid_phase) %>%
      write_csv(here("data", "processed",
                     paste0("mrt_", prefix, "_arrivals_", phase_file[[ph]], ".csv")))
  }
}
```

```{r Monthly-average flow}
# Monthly-average flow from each origin subzone into each centre, by phase and period,
# then classify origin subzones by cumulative share of inflow (Hou et al. 2025)
od_train_21_26 %>%
  filter(dest_centre != "Other") %>%
  mutate(covid_phase = phase_of(YEAR, MONTH)) %>%
  group_by(covid_phase, period, centre = dest_centre, origin_sz) %>%
  summarise(trips = sum(trips), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(phase_months, by = "covid_phase") %>%
  mutate(trips = trips / n_months) %>%
  group_by(covid_phase, period, centre) %>%
  arrange(desc(trips), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    share      = trips / sum(trips),
    cum_before = cumsum(share) - share,
    shed = case_when(
      cum_before < 0.25 ~ "Core",
      cum_before < 0.50 ~ "Strong",
      cum_before < 0.75 ~ "Weak",
      TRUE              ~ "Peripheral"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() -> service_shed

# Check: number of subzones in each class
service_shed %>%
  count(covid_phase, period, centre, shed) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = shed, values_from = n)
```

```{r mapping}
bb_sg <- st_bbox(st_transform(m_subzone, 3414))   # same extent for every panel

# One panel: service shed of one centre, in one phase and period
shed_panel <- function(phase, period_name, cc, tag) {
  shed_cc <- service_shed %>%
    filter(covid_phase == phase, period == period_name, centre == cc) %>%
    select(SUBZONE_N = origin_sz, shed)

  map_data <- m_subzone %>%
    left_join(shed_cc, by = "SUBZONE_N") %>%
    mutate(shed = factor(replace_na(shed, "No flow"), levels = shed_levels))

  outline <- m_subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% centre_sz[[cc]]) %>%
    summarise() %>%                      # merge the centre's subzones into one outline
    mutate(centre = cc)

    sg_map(map_data, shed, values = shed_colours, breaks = shed_breaks,
         labels = shed_labels, outline = outline, centre_label = "",
         legend = "right", bb = bb_sg,
         mrt_lines = if (phase == "SD control") mrt_lines_old else mrt_lines_all,
         title = paste0("(", tag, ") ", cc))
}

# Full figure: the four centres for one phase and period
shed_figure <- function(phase, period_name) {
  n_m <- phase_months$n_months[phase_months$covid_phase == phase]

  map2(c("CBD", "Jurong Lake District", "Woodlands", "Tampines"), letters[1:4],
       ~ shed_panel(phase, period_name, .x, .y)) %>%
    wrap_plots(ncol = 2) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = paste0("MRT/LRT service sheds (", period_name, ", ", phase, " period)"),
      subtitle = "Origin subzones ranked by their share of MRT/LRT trips entering the centre (cumulative %).",
      caption  = paste0("Data: LTA DataMall passenger volume by OD (MRT/LRT), monthly average of ",
                        n_m, " months; URA Master Plan 2019 subzones.")
    )
}

# Draw and save every phase x period
for (ph in names(phase_file)) {
  for (p in names(period_prefix)) {
    fig <- shed_figure(ph, p)
    print(fig)
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("shed_", phase_file[[ph]], "_", period_prefix[[p]], ".png")),
           fig, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

```{r Principal shed}
# Principal shed = core + strong
principal <- service_shed %>%
  filter(shed %in% c("Core", "Strong")) %>%
  select(covid_phase, period, centre, origin_sz)

# Off-diagonal: principal subzones shared by centres i and j
principal %>%
  inner_join(principal, by = c("covid_phase", "period", "origin_sz"),
             suffix = c("_i", "_j"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(centre_i != centre_j) %>%
  count(covid_phase, period, centre_i, centre_j, name = "n_shared") -> shared

principal %>%
  count(covid_phase, period, centre_j = centre, name = "n_j") -> n_principal

# Diagonal: self-containment (share of j's principal subzones not shared with any other centre)
principal %>%
  add_count(covid_phase, period, origin_sz, name = "n_centres") %>%
  group_by(covid_phase, period, centre_j = centre) %>%
  summarise(self = mean(n_centres == 1), .groups = "drop") -> self_contain

# O(i, j) = shared subzones / subzones in centre j's principal shed
expand_grid(covid_phase = names(phase_file),
            period      = names(period_prefix),
            centre_i    = centres,
            centre_j    = centres) %>%
  left_join(shared,       by = c("covid_phase", "period", "centre_i", "centre_j")) %>%
  left_join(n_principal,  by = c("covid_phase", "period", "centre_j")) %>%
  left_join(self_contain, by = c("covid_phase", "period", "centre_j")) %>%
  mutate(overlap = if_else(centre_i == centre_j, self, replace_na(n_shared, 0) / n_j)) %>%
  select(covid_phase, period, centre_i, centre_j, overlap) -> overlap_matrix

write_csv(overlap_matrix, here("data", "processed", "mrt_overlap_matrix.csv"))

# Two matrices (SD control | non-control) for one time period
overlap_figure <- function(period_name) {
  mat <- function(phase, tag) {
    stylized_matrix(centre_j, centre_i, overlap,
                    data = filter(overlap_matrix, covid_phase == phase, period == period_name),
                    limits = c(0, 1), legend_title = "Overlap",
                    title = phase, tag = tag)
  }

  (mat("SD control", "A") | mat("Non-control", "B")) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title   = paste0("Overlap of principal service sheds (", period_name, ")"),
      caption = paste0("O(i, j) = share of centre j's principal-shed subzones (column) that are also ",
                       "in centre i's (row); diagonal = self-containment.\n",
                       "Principal shed = core + strong.")
    ) &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

for (p in names(period_prefix)) {
  fig <- overlap_figure(p)
  print(fig)
  ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("overlap_", period_prefix[[p]], ".png")),
         fig, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```
